##### Project general facts

Masaar 3 Sedra by Arada is the fourth phase of the forested Masaar community, a nature-inspired residential enclave designed for a calm and balanced lifestyle. Contemporary facades blend organically with the surrounding green spaces, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious standalone villas with four and five bedrooms, each with refined layouts, high ceilings, private gardens, terraces and dedicated parking spaces.

Residents enjoy a rich ecosystem of amenities centred on wellness, movement and community living. A swimmable forest lagoon with waterfalls, jogging and cycling tracks through shaded green corridors, family pools and wellness zones encourage an active routine. An outdoor cinema, children's adventure playgrounds, basketball and padel courts and a duck pond add variety, while cafes, a mosque, a community centre, retail and food truck parks enhance everyday convenience and social life.

Homes are finished to a contemporary, high-quality standard with a refined and understated aesthetic. Every residence includes a smart home system for comfort, security and energy efficiency, and kitchens are equipped with a cooking range, a hood and a washer and dryer for everyday readiness. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each villa or townhouse easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Masaar is a forested master-planned community in Sharjah, where homes are set among tree-lined green corridors, parks and shaded walking and cycling paths. Community pools, sports courts, play areas, cafes, a mosque and a community centre create a calm, family-oriented setting, while Masaar Central adds retail, dining and everyday services within easy reach of every neighbourhood.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Masaar Central, Tilal Mall, Nasma Central Park and the Sharjah Mosque are a short drive away, while Sharjah International Airport, University City and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, along with schools, clinics and hospitals serving local families.

Masaar is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the best-selling green residential destinations in the UAE. Spacious villas and townhouses surrounded by nature attract families seeking more space at accessible prices compared with Dubai. Low service charges, an established community and strong road links support steady demand from end users and tenants, underpinning long-term value for owners and investors.
